title: pvImageShrink
body:
## pvImageShrink

Reduces the resolution of an image or volume (vtkImageData) by integer factors per axis, either by averaging each block of input pixels (ParaView default) or by keeping every nth pixel. The output spacing grows by the same factors. Use it to make large images manageable for preview or export; use resample or pvResampleToImage for non-integer target resolutions.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Plain subsampling (Averaging false) can alias fine structure; keep averaging for continuous fields.
- Averaging mixes values, so do not use it on label or mask images; switch Averaging off for those.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ImageShrink`. Identity: `filters/ImageShrink`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Image Shrink filter. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Averaging` | If the value of this property is 1, an average of neighborhood scalar values will be used as the output scalar value for each output point. If its value is 0, only subsampling will be performed, and the original scalar values at the points will be retained. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ShrinkFactors` | The value of this property indicates the amount by which to shrink along each axis. | `{"items":{"maximum":100,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvImageShrink",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
